status: Recommendation only; no new model or GPU execution authorized by this document
priority: Test untreated context variation before treating scalar energy as a general steering alarm
candidate: Keep the simple diagonal baseline-referenced energy as the practical candidate; preserve the norm and full-shrinkage quadratic audits. This is a post-results recommendation, not retrospective confirmation of the selected candidate.
reference_requirement: Prepare a substantially more diverse BASE-only reference spanning question type, prefix length and continuation vocabulary. Use whole-context TRAIN, calibration and TEST groups. Existing4 TRAIN prompts cannot calibrate a trustworthy global false-positive rate, especially prefill.
freeze_before_new_results: Fix phase-specific means/variances, the existing0.1 shrinkage, all24 uniform weights, first8 window and any BASE-calibration-only threshold. Retain prefill and decode diagnostics; do not silently drop the dominant first position. Keep a fresh untreated TEST panel to measure context-induced false alarms.
controlled_next_experiment: After BASE calibration, attach the frozen monitor to one narrowly budgeted same-token signed-strength experiment. Compare0,+/-strength along v plus random-direction and norm-only controls. Existing study06 strength proposal is retained unexecuted and would need an explicit revised freeze if this monitor or controls change its specification.
criteria: Energy effect must replicate on held-out contexts and remain distinguishable from untreated context variation at the frozen threshold. Report all directions, both phases and false-positive/miss counts. A scalar that rises for random perturbations measures general disturbance; it is not specific to the known vector or its meaning.
mechanism_question: If a true potential is the goal, separately test whether full-state layer updates align with minus its gradient and whether the same function descends with context/memory treated appropriately. Our quadratic anomaly function has no such established property.
behavioral_extension: For computational impact, later collect paired next-token distributions under a fixed context and compare KL with energy changes; local pullback Fisher cost is a literature-grounded extension. Do not claim logits, derivatives or behavior were measured in today's residual-only audit.
resource_policy: GPU remains released during review, design and CPU work. Any future native experiment requires fresh resource admission, time estimate and verified export/release accounting. Do not allocate Research3 resources or change the user CPU Drive mount.
